name: South Atlantic Current
scope: Declared western intermediate-depth SAC reference reach from a 40 W, 39 S current-center context gate to the 16 W, 43 S Mid-Atlantic Ridge float-reach context gate. Excludes upstream Brazil/Falkland confluence paths, unresolved eastern-basin continuation and recirculation. Not a complete current or a digitized float trajectory.
layer: Intermediate/Antarctic Intermediate Water context from subsurface floats; no velocity core, exact isopycnal or uniform-depth axis reconstructed. Surface STF geography does not replace this layer scope.
time_convention: Study observations span December 1992–October 1996; selected route is an editorial geographic reach, not a time-mean axis, dated trajectory or seasonal curve.
source_locator: Section 3.5, journal pp. 381–383 / PDF pp. 27–29: current center near 40 W, 39 S; easternmost RAFOS reach near 43 S, 16 W; large meanders and possible SAC/ACC exchange. Figure 11 is context only, not digitized.
source_citation: Boebel, Schmid and Zenk (1999), Kinematic elements of Antarctic Intermediate Water in the western South Atlantic, Deep-Sea Research II 46, 355–392, doi:10.1016/S0967-0645(98)00104-0.
source_license: Elsevier article all rights reserved; cited factual anchor locations only. No source figure, curve, velocity field or float data copied.
coordinate_selection: Source provides two approximate geographic anchors with different support: current-center description and farthest float reach. OSW connects them with coarse offshore waypoints and declares alternative shapes. These points do not define the whole SAC endpoints, one parcel path, uniform-depth core or measured meander length.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Alternative editorial bend between the same source anchors; not observed seasonal contraction.
Alternative editorial bend between the same source anchors; not a reconstruction of documented large meanders.

scenario_rule: Three declared reach shapes crossed with uniform longitude shifts -0.5/0/+0.5 degrees and independent endpoint latitude shifts -1/0/+1 degrees: 81 editorial sensitivity scenarios, not statistical uncertainty or seasonal bounds.
remaining_gates: Validate source anchor interpretation, depth and regional naming independently; the farthest observed float reach is not a whole-current endpoint.
Acquire dated float or suitable velocity geometry before measuring physical meander length; do not transfer this reach to the surface current.
Resolve eastern-basin continuation, SAC/ACC exchange and recirculation before a full-current length.
Keep all annual dimensions and physical width unresolved; complete canonical measurement and publication review separately.
